message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build and test
on: push

env:
    # we use these in .ci.maven.settings.xml, which is needed to authenticate for core (!) GitHub packages
    MAVEN_SETTINGS_USERNAME_FOR_GITHUB: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_SETTINGS_USERNAME_FOR_GITHUB }}
    MAVEN_SETTINGS_PASSWORD_FOR_GITHUB: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_SETTINGS_PASSWORD_FOR_GITHUB }}
    GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

jobs:
    build:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest

        steps:
            -   uses: actions/checkout@v4
            -   name: Cache Maven dependencies
                uses: actions/cache@v4
                with:
                    path: ~/.m2/repository
                    key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
                    restore-keys: |
                      ${{ runner.os }}-maven-
            -   name: Set up JDK 21
                uses: actions/setup-java@v4
                with:
                    java-version: '21'
                    distribution: 'temurin'
                    server-id: github
            -   name: Build with Maven
                run: mvn --batch-mode --update-snapshots verify
            -   name: Set jsprit version (tagged only)
                run: mvn versions:set -DnewVersion=${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v} -DgenerateBackupPoms=false --no-transfer-progress
                if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
            -   name: Publish to GitHub Packages
                if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
                run: mvn --batch-mode deploy -B --no-transfer-progress -DskipTests
                env:
                    GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
",
  "rationale": "The workflow builds a Maven project on every push without caching dependencies. Adding Maven dependency caching via actions/cache can reduce build time by avoiding repeated downloads. The pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE from literature reports modest but measurable VM time reduction (6% free, 3.4% paid). Preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs, and cache inputs (pom.xml) are available. No contraindications apply (no existing cache, dependencies are immutable and trusted).",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
